description: A small round mecha flower pup with a cream body, dark flower-shaped spots, mismatched mechanical eyes, a side brass pod, and a calm companion presence faithfully recreated from the reference design.

idle.notes: Quiet baseline idle with tiny blink, tiny breathing, and a barely moving short tail.

walk.notes: Short gentle directional puppy steps with true-facing right and left rows used for walk and drag semantics.

curious.notes: Soft puzzled curiosity with a mild head tilt and calm observant expression.

happy.notes: Restrained shy happiness with a tiny paw lift and softer expression.

sleep.notes: Tucked peaceful dozing loop with the body settled low and eyes closed.

follow.notes: Gentle attentive follow energy, ready to trot after the user without frantic running.

jump.notes: Tiny buoyant hop with anticipation, lift, peak, descent, and settle.

daydream.notes: Quiet absent-minded daydreaming pause repurposed from the fixed atlas row.

drag.notes: Directional drag uses the true-facing locomotion rows.

tidy_tail.notes: Closest gentle expressive loop in the fixed atlas.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: left drag uses the true left-facing row
right drag uses the true right-facing row
walk_left and walk_right are not swapped
flower-shaped spots, mismatched eyes, side brass pod, and short tail remain coordinated with body direction in both rows
Petal remains readable at small size as a flower-spotted mecha pup rather than a generic bear or plush toy

baseSceneIdentity.subject: small round mechanical flower pup
baseSceneIdentity.posture: compact seated or tucked puppy with a slightly oversized head
signatureFeatures: dark gray-brown irregular flower-shaped spot markings
one large pale eye and one smaller brass mechanical eye
subtle seam lines and tiny brass joints
baseSceneIdentity.mood: quiet, gentle, soft, daydreaming, and companion-like
